I'm not being flippant with the gif. Self-doubt keeps me up at night as well & it's a negative feedback loop, as tiredness exacerbates anxiety. It's a battle, but learning to accept yourself for what you are, rather than what you want to be helps. Incremental improvement is key.

ACT - Acceptance Commitment Therapy: You should be able to find lots of books on the subject. Learning to live with who & what you are, accepting it & then committing to make changes to the aspects of yourself you don't like is amazingly powerful. It fixed my insomnia in days.
